description: Campaigns attributed in ThreatNexus. With an actor: that actor's curated dossier campaigns plus campaign names from recent reporting about it. Without one: campaign names from recent reporting across approved actors, newest first. Filter by keyword or to active campaigns.

active_only.description: Only campaigns reported inside the active window (reporting) or with no end date (curated).

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".
